Problem Statement
Insert the given keys into a hash table of size m using:
h(key) = key % m
If a collision occurs, use linear probing:
(index + 1) % m
Print the final hash table.
Input Format
First line contains m and n.
Second line contains n integers.
Output Format
Print the final hash table.
Sample Input
7 4
10 17 24 31
Sample Output
31 24 -1 10 17 -1 -1
